title: docs(studio-redesign): move the 61 PR screenshots under after/ to an evidence branch and remove them from main
body:
Fixes #12579
Clause-②: no

## What changed

- Deletes `docs/design/studio-redesign/after/`: 61 PNG screenshots (about 8.2 MB) that came from the skeleton (objectui#12459) and the lane cards. This follows the maintainer's ruling 「截图不进 main，统一用证据分支」, recorded as `6203198157` on objectui#12446.
- Nothing else changes. The 8 artboard pairs beside the README (`*.html` and `*.png`) and the README itself are untouched: they are design sources, not screenshots.
- No changeset: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exits 0 with "No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed."
- No history rewrite: every file stays reachable at the merge commit that added it.

## Where the screenshots live now

Evidence branch `claude/studio-redesign-after-evidence` at `6f5dc6b30c83e4e23fa1bfd87ee8c69e0ef33328`. That is a main commit pushed as is, with no new commit. All 61 paths resolve there at their old paths. One commit-pinned link per card prefix:
